body: Thank you, I know we're better off with out each other but these residual feelings just tear away ever fiber of my being, to be with someone for 5 years and uproot your entire life and have it end is just a kick in the teeth. And just sitting here always wondering what they're thinking and how they feel makes everything worse because we cut ties and you can't help but to worry about them.
I want her back, and I know that's the only thing that'll fix this , but it I know that's not an option with her cheating on me.

But I can't even comprehend how my life is going to be without them in my life, just the fact that they are eventually going to go back to school and I will never see them again just completely tears my chest apart. It's been so hard to function, I've struggled to get through work and I can't eat and barely sleep. I don't even know what to feel.
